records.title: IRRIGATION PROJECTS IN THE STATE OF PUNJAB
details:
There are one major multipurpose project, two Extension, Renovation and Modernization (ERM) 
projects and one Command Area Development and Water Management (CAD&WM) project, being partially 
funded by Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, under progress in the 
State of Punjab.

records.title: MODERNISATION PLAN OF SCL, MOHALI
details:
SCL, Mohali is being upgraded on the modern lines and government will invest Rs 4500 crore.
This will include a large-scale increase in production capacity, targeting 100 times production of
wafers from current levels.

records.title: MODERNISATION PLAN OF SCL, MOHALI
details: (a) to (d): The Government is in the process of taking inputs from the concerned stakeholders for modernization of SCL Mohali.

records.title: Gis and Platform workers
details: A Committee comprising representatives from stakeholders has also been constituted to suggest inter-alia, framework for providing social security and welfare benefits to gig and platform workers.

records.title: Hriday in Amritsar
details: (e) & (f): No, Sir. Impact evaluation study of the HRIDAY scheme has not been done. Procedure for appointing a suitable agency to conduct the Impact evaluation study of the scheme is under process.

records.title: Gram Nyayalas in Punjab
details: (a to e) It was inter alia stated that as per information provided by the Punjab and Haryana, High Court, establishment of additional Gram Nyayalayas at other locations in Punjab is under active consideration.
